spec_case: electricity/docs/spec/tools-adapters-plugins.md §7 case 15 (the tool side: a raised, status-less failure)
description: A connection refused against a closed loopback port is a URLError-wrapped RuntimeError (ErrorCause::NoReply) -- always retryable with no HTTP status at all, unlike a returned ok: false result. retries.max_attempts: 2 means the tool actually retries once before the run fails; the OS's own 'connection refused' errno text differs by platform, so only the Circuitry-owned prefix is compared.
